ai40_scope.scope: The preselected 40-question subset of 206 published answer_in_text=1 questions; not all 227 test questions.

bootstrap.method: Paired source-cluster bootstrap; question-weighted score means and pooled count ratios. Same cluster draws for all conditions and within-question contrasts.
bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory intervals conditional on the selected subset and grouping assumptions; not an estimate of human-rater validity or population representativeness.
